user_reviews.Name: Sandra Chinoporos
user_reviews.Description:
Fidel Gomez and the Gomez Sewer & Drain business are amazing! They are incredibly communicative and respectful of their cutomers' time. For example, on each visit, Fidel texted to let me know exactly what time he would be arriving. The first time he came to install a new bathroom faucet, Fidel took one look at the faucet set I had purchased ahead of time and recommended that I order a different, more reputable brand that would provide better quality and durability. Instead, he checked in after the visit to see if the new faucet had arrived yet and once it did, he scheduled a return appointment that was convenient for *my* schedule. The work he did to replace not only the faucet, but also new flush valves for my toilet was suberb. He took extra care to keep the bathroom clean and free of debris, making sure to clean up after himself. And during each of his visits, he was pleasant, efficient, and professional.

I cannot recommend Gomez Sewer & Drain enough. A++++++ !!!

user_reviews.Name: Gregory Dibb
user_reviews.Description:
I needed my septic tank completely pumped out so I could start getting rid of it.  I called a couple of different places and Able had the best price, but they charge extra if it takes them longer than half an hour.  Well they came and did a fabulous job.  Very helpful, very thorough--helped dig around the tank, etc.  The only problem is it took them 1.5 hours, which ended up costing me quite a bit more than the original quote.  For me 5 star service would mean that before working that extra time and going that extra mile they ask me.  I might have said yes because they did do a good job, but I might have been okay after just 30 mins.

So my advice to company is: ask the customer if they prefer the extra work/cleaning or if they prefer to rush and stay under 30 mins.  my advice to customer: be clear you expect the job to be done in 30 mins, so they aren't extra helpful and then charge you for it.

Still feel we did not get a good value from the company, but learned an expensive lesson about dealing with stressful home repairs.

I called four different plumbers to get estimates with Drain Doctor being the first one I called.  A little history of my previous water heater is in order.  in 2019 I was overseas, and the heater broke and leaked all over the garage damaging some important personal items.  My girlfriend at the time called a plumber who installed a new heater and what a mess it was.  That plumber used galvanized steel for the inlet and outlet of the heater lines.  Routed the pressure relief pipe into the water heater pan rather than outside of the pan and installed my recirculating pump facing the side wall where I could not gain access.  Additionally, the gas line reservoir was installed by the water heater rather than near the gas line valve coming out of the wall.  There were no 2x4 boards in the back of the heater for earth quake bracing and the water lines were not earth grounded, all of which are city compliance requirement.  To say the least it was a cluster F.  When Bobby from Drain doctor showed up, he immediately pointed out the nonconformance of the water heater and gave me a bottom-line price from his standard pricing book which no other plumbers could beat.  Some quotes were almost double and after negotiating with those plumbers they got close to Bobby's price which didn't sit well with me.  So, I decided to go with Bobby and that proved to be fortuitist based on his efficient and compliant work.  Bobby is a plethora of plumbing information or more like a Wikipedia of plumbing.  He does have a laid back and straight forward attitude but don't let that fool you.  He's the top gun in his industry.  Anyway, I've read some of the negative reviews and in each case, there has been a unique set circumstance that all of us experienced in our daily life but over 99%+ of Drain Doctor reviews are very positive.  I can't tell you how happy we are with his work and in fact our outside main water line inlet valve was broken, unbeknown to us and we had him come back the next day to fix that as well.  I didn't bother getting other quotes because I knew Bobby would give us a competitive price but more importantly do the job right.
Anyway, you can't go wrong with Drain Doctor and ask for Bobby.  Bobby is your man.
Lastley, I don’t usually write reviews, but I was so impressed with the work I was compelled to write about our experience.
Thank you,
John A.

user_reviews.Name: dusty simon
user_reviews.Description:
I had a very disappointing experience with Roto-Rooter on a recent sewer job. I paid around $10,000 for work that is still not completed over a week later, and communication has been extremely poor throughout the process.

During the excavation, a trench over 7 feet deep was left open and workers entered the hole without any shoring or trench protection in place. This created serious safety concerns and appeared to violate basic OSHA safety requirements. I also have video evidence of the conditions on site.

In addition, there was an attempt to upsell me an additional “two-way cleanout” for about $6,000 after the original work was already underway and paid for. I have video evidence of that conversation as well, and it felt misleading based on how it was presented.

On top of that, the equipment used on my property caused damage to my sidewalk. The area where heavy machinery was placed is now holding water, which was not an issue before the work began and suggests either compaction or grading damage.

Overall, the job remains unfinished, communication has been lacking, and I am now dealing with both safety concerns and property damage. I am currently pursuing resolution through formal channels.
If you have Roger Leon show up expect to spend big money on false claims

user_reviews.Name: Misha S
user_reviews.Description:
I had a great experience with Freddy and his team at Freedom Underground at my Menlo Park residence.

It was a hairy situation where I needed to install a new sewer line down a shared driveway and into the public street. Various permits and inspections from the city as well as the sanitary district were needed, I had some concerned neighbors to deal with, and we had to do it in a way that protects a large heritage tree right near the work.

Freddy was extremely patient and creative during the scoping process. He understood the requirements and concerns of all parties involved and offered different solutions based on what the needs were. He and his office manager Fiona did a good job of managing all the admin stuff as well. I never felt like the team didn't know what they were doing or didn't have a plan.

Once the job started, Miguel did an excellent job managing the work and the team. His communication was great and he quickly corrected course based on any concerns or requirements raised. Miguel was a good foreman.

I felt in good hands the whole time and I thought the team was very diligent in cleaning up each day, keeping me updated on progress, etc. I'd definitely work with them again.

user_reviews.Name: Mahmud Ischanov
user_reviews.Description:
My 60 year old galvanized main water line pipe decided to spring a leak one cold Saturday evening... I had to scramble to turn the water off at the meter. As soon as I did, I started calling around plumbers that could come out quick to help me fix the pipe, as i had no water in the house of 5 people. No showers, washing hands or using toilets.
4 guys came out, Freddy from Freedom was 2nd lowest offer. What sold me on his quote was that he was going to use a trenchless tunneling system called the HammerHead (minimize trenching and destruction of 50 feet of my yard) and the fact that he suggested that he install a pressure regulator without being asked (unlike the other plumbers). The pressure regulator is important because after replacing a 60 year old corroded galvanized steel pipe with brand new copper line, the water pressure in the house could go up dramatically, causing damage to appliances and pipes in the house. Freddy even agreed to install a Flo by Moen leak detection system at no additional charge.
I am glad I decided to go with Freddy, his guys showed up on time the next morning, as agreed. His crew of guys (Christian and 4 others) worked non-stop, tirelessly and professionally. I could definitely tell the guys take pride in their work, they all did a fantastic job.
I would recommend Freddy and Freedom Underground, they are awesome!

user_reviews.Name: Ashish Kalani
user_reviews.Description:
Freedom Underground Plumbing replaced our main sewer and water lines. The main sewer line replacement was done entirely trench-less, whereas the water line replacement was a combination of trench-less and open trench. The entire work was done in a timely manner and with great quality; we passed inspections without any issues. The water line replacement was a bit complex with multiple turns. The crew used smooth turns on the line where possible and we have had no drop in water pressure in the house or in the irrigation lines. The crew did its best to leave the landscape looking as much like before as possible. They even put back the grass cover that had to be removed for digging a wide hole.

Freddy, the owner, gave me a quote that was competitive with the others I received. However I chose to go with Freedom Underground because Freddy genuinely seemed interested in providing the best solution for our needs. The foremen, Alex and Christian were both very responsive to my questions and kept me up-to-date with what was being done. I requested a change-order for replacing part of the sewer line under the house, and the quote provided was reasonable.

Overall, I am very happy with the experience and whole-heartedly recommend Freedom Underground for underground replacement work.

I could not be more satisfied with the work done and how much attention was paid by Thomas to leaving my property in good and clean, tidy repair.  I recommend this company!

From the moment he arrived, he treated me with patience, kindness, and respect. I am hard of hearing and move slowly because of arthritis, and he never once rushed me. He took his time to listen carefully and explain everything in a way I could understand.

He didn’t just fix the problem — he checked my whole plumbing system to make sure everything was safe. No plumber has ever done that for me before.

He even had to cut into some of the stucco to do the repair properly, and I was worried the price might go up. It never did. He kept his word exactly. That meant a lot to me.

In my long life, I have met many contractors. Joseph stands out as one of the most honest, hardworking, and compassionate young men I have ever encountered. His workmanship is beautiful, and his character is even better.

If you want someone who truly cares, who does the job right, and who treats you like family, call Allstar Plumbing and ask for Joseph.

Thank you, Joseph. You really are an Allstar.

Giovani is simply the best! He knows his work and does not charge you an arm and a leg.
He is responsive, honest and punctual. I really appreciate how he explains the problem in layman terms so that I fully understand the issue.

This is a special shout out for the awesome work he did a few years ago, which is long over due.... I wanted to get a bidet installed and had a special request which was for it to be connected from the sink vanity so that I can have hot and cold functionality. Giovani listened to my idea and quoted me a reasonable price to do the work. I was very particular about being able to check if there might be a leak in the future since the connection was coming through a wall.. and also bidets are known to start leaking. Giovani came up with a brilliant idea of not sealing the cover plate which allowed me to check between the wall for any leaks.
It's been more than 4 years since he installed this and there are no leaks. Just goes to show he knows his craft well.

He also replaced toilets and fixed some leaks around the house. Giovani is my go to person for any plumbing projects/repairs.

user_reviews.Name: Elaine Chang
user_reviews.Description: I've never written a review before but Giovani did such a superb job that I had to!  My house of horrors from the 1960s has seen more than it's fair share of plumbers coming through but hands down, San Jose Drain and Main is the real deal.  My 13 year old son (who doesn't know his own strength) broke the shower handle.  Unfortunately, it wasn't as simple as replacing the shower handle as the shower cartridge was stuck and the valve needed to be replaced.  I contacted 7 plumbers before I reached out to Giovani and they all said the tile had to be broken in order to access the valve and replace it.  Giovani said he wasn't sure if he had to break the tile but he would try to avoid it. He ran through his proposed solution with me and it made sense so I had Giovani come back another day after he bought the parts.  He came on time as promised and took out the old cartridge and valve and welded the new valve into a very tight space (see picture) without having to break the tile!  He gave me a quote at the beginning of the job and even though it took way longer than anticipated (he was here from 2 pm to 7:30 pm), he still stuck to his original quote.  Now, that's what I call service and a job well done! Thank you Giovani and San Jose Drain and Main!!!

user_reviews.Name: Dalena
user_reviews.Description:
Cesar and Francisco came out this week to help us diagnose ongoing drain clogs and a persistent odor issue at my business, and I cannot recommend them enough.

From the moment they arrived, they were punctual, professional, and incredibly thorough. As a business owner, I had a long list of questions and concerns, and they took the time to patiently walk me through every single detail without ever making me feel rushed.

Since I didn’t have access to the plumbing blueprints for our plaza, they went above and beyond by using a camera and locator to accurately map out the pipe system, including identifying shared lines. That level of effort alone gave me so much clarity and peace of mind.

They conducted a full camera inspection, explained the condition and age of the pipes, and helped me clearly understand what was causing the issues. What really stood out was how knowledgeable and honest they were. They didn’t only point out problems, they provided multiple solutions and helped me choose the most practical and cost-effective option.

Their customer service was unmatched compared to the many plumber we’ve had before. They were patient, transparent, and genuinely cared about helping us solve the issue the right way. On top of that, they provided a detailed report that made everything easy to understand and reference moving forward.

If you’re looking for a plumbing team that is reliable, skilled, and goes above and beyond for their clients, Cesar and Francisco are the ones to call. I will for sure be using them for any future needs!

user_reviews.Name: Joe Falcone
user_reviews.Description: The work was OK, the problem was the loose relationship with the truth and upsell.  We had a clogged toilet and the normal approach without an accessible cleanout would be to remove the toilet ($500) plus snake the line ($500+) and you're done.  Instead they sold us on putting in a two-way cleanout ($3700) which was OK since it needed it anyway but then they tried to sell us on replacing all of the plumbing underneath the house ($11000) claiming that the cast iron sewer line had corroded and crumbled.  See the flow of the line in the video - it was perfectly fine.  The guy that is initially sent out is a salesman - not sure he's a licensed plumber since he doesn't do any of the work, just the estimate.  He tries to maximize the value of the deal for the plumbing company.  Bottom line: use a local plumber with good references who doesn't try to upsell.

user_reviews.Name: Toan Nguyen
user_reviews.Description:
My kitchen sink got clogged yesterday and I tried to unclog it as I did many times before but it didn’t work this time. My wife called “Drain Assist” and Trieu showed up in 20’ later. Trieu look at everything and tried to find out where it got clogged. He tried the easy way first by using his professional air gun to push down the clog from the sink. but it didn’t work. He checked clean out and couldn’t find the clog there and he suspected that the clog is in the horizontal pipe that connects the P-trap and the big vertical pipe in the wall.
He is right. As he un-assembled the kitchen pipe connectors and don’t see much clog in the P-trap but the horizontal pipe  totally blocked the water flow w/ grease/food traps over the years. He use big snake tool to pull/push to clean the inside of the pipe. I could see how tough the clog was, but he has all the professional tool to do the job. He also ran the hot water to clean the grease inside the pipe to make sure it clean well.
After that, he assembled all plumbing back then tested the water flow and checked for any leaks.
Trieu works w/ his heart and tries to bring the best outcome for his customer. You can’t be wrong to call him to help when in need at your house or your business. I will call him again if I need help in the future.
Drain Assist is AAA+++ service w/ affordable price.

I will definitely recommend Trieu to everyone that needs plumbing service!

user_reviews.Name: Teri Chiang
user_reviews.Description: I could not be happier with the HUGE job EJ Plumbing did for me. My slow shower drain turned out to be caused by disintegrated plumbing under my 70-year old house (tree roots came up when they snaked the drain, ugh). Jonathan was extremely helpful in diagnosing it, and supervisor Ryan Kennedy came right away to work out potential solutions to a very extensive and expensive problem. Ryan and Jonathan used a camera with a tracker to trace the issue through the lines. No perfect options with rotting plumbing under a slab. They listened to my priorities and we agreed on the best, least invasive solution. They came out promptly to start the job - a whole team digging through my brick walkway and front yard to replace the outdoor line, followed by cutting into my drywall to spray an epoxy liner through my indoor lines. They were extremely careful, hardworking and professional. Best of all, they took such incredible care putting everything back, including my yard, drywall and checkerboard brick walkway. Above and beyond!!! I am so impressed. Very very happy with EJ's honesty, reliability, professionalism, skill and even artistry. I had used them before for a small, simple job but this was a huge, difficult effort and I could not be more pleased. Thanks to Ryan, Jonathan, Ivan, Gerardo and the whole team at EJ for your excellent service!!!

I've always been told that if I need plumbing work done, I should call a professional, but that doesn't imply such professionals always act professionally. user_reviews.Description: I hired Jose’s plumbing in January 2026 to re-pipe my entire home which had Pex plastic water pipes and to replace all the Pex with copper water pipes. Jose came to my house to take a look at what I had going on. He was very knowledgeable and answered all my questions. He provided me with timely quote for the work I wanted to have completed. I got 4 estimates for this job. Jose was not the  low bidder nor was he the highest. Low bidder is not always best from my perspective. My home is 4 bedroom with 3 full baths with a laundry room. Jose told me that he could complete this job in 1 day. I thought there is no way all that work would get done in 1 day and that he was just trying to get the work. We agreed on a start day. Jose asked that I clear out under all the sinks and move some other things out of the way so they could get right to work when they showed up. Jose said he would be there at 8:00am. Jose and his crew were all on time. Jose brought 8 plumbers with him and got right to work. They protected all my floors & walls and tented all the areas they were going to be working to capture any dust and materials. The crew took a 30 min lunch and right back to work. When they finshed all the work, they all cleaned everything up. Jose tested the system for about 30 mins just to make sure there were no leaks. Everything was good. They took all the old materials with them. I certainly had the choice on what plumbing company I wanted to do this job. Jose and his Crew were top notch and hardworking. It was quite impressive that they finished this large job in 1 day. I had a couple questions the next day and Jose said he would send 1 of his guys over to my home that afternoon to show me in person. It was a really good experience for me. I was really happy with Jose’s Plumbing and there talented Crew. I highly recommend Jose’s Plumbing for all your plumbing needs.

user_reviews.Name: Yupeng Zou
user_reviews.Description:
I had a great experience with Repipe Champion for my whole-house PEX repipe project. Travis was the person I worked with, and he was very responsive and professional throughout the process. He identified that there was an active leak in my house and was able to schedule an emergency repipe within a week, which was especially impressive because that timeline also included getting the permit.

The repipe work itself was completed very quickly. Most of the project was finished within two days: one day for opening the walls and completing the repipe work, and another day for patching. There was a small hiccup during the process when some electrical outlets stopped working, but the team handled it responsibly and had an electrician come out on the third day to fix the issue. In the end, the whole project only took three days, with a fourth day for the final inspection, which should take less than an hour.

Overall, I’m very happy with the result. The price was also very competitive compared to the other quotes I received. I would highly recommend Repipe Champion to anyone dealing with a leak problem and looking for fast, reliable repipe service.

user_reviews.Name: Alex Koretsky
user_reviews.Description:
I can't recommend SPS Plumbing enough as they saved me thousands and restored my faith in honest service! My tankless water heater (just 4 months out of warranty) started acting up, so I called three different plumbers. All of them even highly rated ones on Yelp and Google, inspected it and said I needed a full replacement. The quotes?  6,000 to 8,000. I was devastated, thinking I'd have to shell out a fortune.

I vented to a friend about it, and they immediately suggested Steve at SPS Plumbing. I called, and Steve and Vanessa were amazing from the get-go. They listened to my story, calmed me down, and assured me not to worry and they could fix it without replacing the whole unit. Their quote came in under $500 for parts and labor. What a relief!

They ordered the parts right away and scheduled the repair for just a day after everything arrived. Ruben showed up on time, was super friendly and professional, and knocked out the entire job quickly and cleanly. My water heater's been running perfectly ever since.

Honestly, I feel like those other plumbers were either trying to take advantage of the situation or just didn't know how to handle the repair. Don't fall for the big-ticket upsell just call SPS first. Steve, Vanessa, and Ruben are the real pros. Grateful beyond words!

user_reviews.Name: Crystal Yensko
user_reviews.Description: I found United HVAC and Plumbing via yelp when I was looking to get a leak fixed in my front yard. I had two estimates done, one by a competitor and one by United. The first company that came out quoted me an exorbitant amount for work that they couldn’t guarantee would fix the problem. I got a second opinion through United, and was very impressed with Igor and Oscar. They explained the entire process and offered me multiple options to fix my leak. I ended up having them replace my water main and put in copper piping. After signing the work order, they came out very next day and completed the job. These guys used shovels to dig up/ trench my yard (which was, in my opinion-backbreaking work) removed all old pipes, laid new copper pipes, replaced the old main, filled in the trench, and secured the ground back in place all in one day. They did an excellent job and were very personable. They also gave me an extremely good price for the work. They then came back the next day to check out my HVAC concerns. Igor took photos of the issues I had in my attic, called around locally to find a new bulb for my REMY HALO unit, fixed a blown fuse in my HVAC unit, and checked out my outside unit as well. Oscar and Igor then gave me a quote for the options I had for my HVAC concerns. The quotes were all beyond reasonable, the prices were unbeatable in our area. When I was concerned about the price of the REMY replacement bulb (I thought they were much less expensive) they offered to provide me with receipts from the supply store that they would be purchasing the part from. That kind of transparency made me feel extremely comfortable with them. I was also told what work would be important to do asap, what could wait, what was unnecessary, and what should be done together to save money. The level of detail this crew went into to help me understand everything, the fact that they did not pressure me into doing unnecessary work, and the high quality of work they did on my plumbing, and the warranty has cemented me as a lifelong customer. I will be calling United for all of my HVAC and plumbing needs in the future, even if their prices go up. The transparency, work ethic, and personality make it entire worth it to me. This is a company that you will feel comfortable reccomending to all of your friends and family!

user_reviews.Name: Roderick Lizardo
user_reviews.Description:
When a plumbing emergency strikes, you want technicians who are not only fast but completely transparent. Tyler and Bryan from Roto-Rooter delivered exactly that. They were dispatched to my home in San Jose (95148) to address a leaking copper pipe leading to the shower and a broken 3" \times 2" San-Tee on the garage drain stack.
From the moment they arrived, their professionalism was top-notch. They immediately identified the issues, but more importantly, they pointed out where a previous remodel by another contractor had left behind incredibly poor craftsmanship and incorrect drainage setups. Instead of just slapping a temporary band-aid on it, Tyler and Bryan systematically demolished the faulty sections and rebuilt everything properly to code.
They fully itemized the $2,900 flat labor charge right on the manifest so there were absolutely no surprises before the final parts and tax were added. Total peace of mind is rare during an urgent repair, but these guys worked cleanly, communicated clearly, and backed up their craftsmanship with a solid warranty. If you need elite, reliable plumbing work in the South Bay, ask for Tyler and Bryan.

user_reviews.Name: Hossein Taheri
user_reviews.Description:
I called because my water heater stopped working. Their technician diagnosed it as a bad faucet cartridge, saying it was causing hot and cold water to mix. I told him I believed it was the water heater because the burner would not turn on, but he insisted the heater was fine and said he was “100% sure” it was the faucet.
Since I needed it fixed quickly, I agreed to replace the cartridge for $740. The next day, the water heater stopped working again. They sent another technician, who said the burner was not working and recommended replacing the water heater.
Before he arrived, I had already gotten quotes from other plumbers for $2,000–$2,300 total. Their technician said he would give me a discount because I had already paid $740, then quoted about $3,000 minus the $740 — basically the same $2,300.
I’m very disappointed with the poor diagnosis, the overpriced faucet repair, and the misleading “discount.” They respond quickly, but their pricing and work ethic are very questionable.

user_reviews.Name: PHUONG SHEFFER
user_reviews.Description:
I am not sure about the price.  It was expensive BUT the services were well worth every pennies.  Basically,  I took over this business over 2 years ago and I notice that one of the sewer in the kitchen was not draining properly,  after numerous calls to Roto-Rooter and many other rooter companies with no results. Eventually that particular drain clogged-up totally a month ago. Before that time, I repeatedly asked the previous owner regarding the condition of the drain and I was told that sewers are working excellently with the usual normal sewer problems. He said that if there were any blockage problems, usually the employees were the one to blame. However, upon observing the staffs working practice,  I did not see any major problem with the way they handled the wasted water.  All of the kitchen staffs told me that there were some problems with the sewer and they asked the previous owner look further into this problem but the previous owner just brushed it off and basically told them to forget it.  Finally,  I decided to contact Roto-Rooter and asked them to look into the clogged sewer problems.  Make the story short, after  a 3 nights of tremendous hard work, the SUPER A-Team, from Roto-Rooter repair the problematic sewer and they pulled out :
One (15 foot long) drain-snake was located in a vertical vent pipe. One ( over 15 foot long) drain-snake was located underneath kitchen floor.  One 8 inches long rubber bladder.  One 3 inches in diameter plastic cap. and two broken drain-snake cable retrieval tool for the sewer pips.  The A-team: Christopher, Scott,  Francisco Garcia & Jacob, David & Elian, Eli & Lucas, and finally, Sanji.  Francisco is the main driving force behind this monumental repair.  Without Francisco,  this gig will never be completed on-time.  He worked hard to minimize the demolition damage to the kitchen floor and making sure the restaurant stay open during the day without major interruption. Cudo to Francisco. Christopher Scott organized the great team for the difficult task. Jacob, David, Elian, Eli and Lucas were the great support team member for the whole operation. Without their dedication, the restaurant would not be able to stay open as promised. Finally,  Sanji, is the Cherry on top for this whole operation. Sanji managed to re-treat a broken spring from the sewer with an improvised hook to pull that item out of the sewer.  I would like express my sincere gratitude  to the A-Team for doing their job professionally, and efficiently.  I would recommend this team to any restaurant owner should they encounter an un foreseen sewer repairing need.

Update 2026:
We recently had low pressure in water softener & these were the guys I first remembered & called. So they made a visit & told would charge me $199(which wasnt the case last year). I was also looking to upgrade my water heater & some electrical upgrade. The quote they sent me was unreasonable from any standards(upgrade is good to have & not need to have). A friend who visited showed us how to bypass the water softener & install a descalar which will not let hard water lump(which is biggest issue) That was $200 solution to thousands of dollars quoted. Anyways, its been three months & I was sent invoice for their visit & I duly paid. But I wont give them anymore business(penny wise, pound foolish I think). I am still looking for a company that can do good job, take honest money & I can depend on.
=====

The technician who came diagnosed it to valve issue & replaced it at very reasonable price. Then they noted some leaks in our sewer & water pipes during crawl space visit. Rinat Shai came with his crew & boy, what a hard worker he is. For the two days he spent under my crawl space, he spent very less time wasting, including lunch break. He went above & beyond to get all the work get finished within promised two days. Infact he worked on both independence day & next day, which most of us spend drinking or traveling. I am very very happy with his work attitude.

I would highly recommend United to anyone considering repairs or upgrades. I look forward to have mutually rewarding business relationship with this company.

user_reviews.Name: Joshua Bloch
user_reviews.Description:
Venture Plumbing did a large and complex repipe on our house, including a new sewer lateral, replacement of all waste pipes in the house, replacement of about 30% of our hot and cold water supply plumbing, replacement of several sinks and toilets, and installation of a Grundfos hot water recirculation system. The work required over a week with a five-person crew and was complicated by the presence of irreplaceable handmade tiles.

Their bid was not the cheapest, but neither was it the most expensive, and they definitely offered value for money. They were happy to accommodate special requests (e.g., installing unions for serviceability), and they are very much full-service plumbers. They contract with subcontractors to do tile and paint work, promising to leave your house in the condition they found it and to leave plumbing fully functional at the end of every working day. In our experience, they did exactly that.

Their communication was excellent before, during, and after the work. Their work exceeded our expectations, and their people exude competence, integrity, friendliness, and respect. They are a big enough organization to get things done quickly and efficiently, but small enough to operate with a human touch. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Description:
I can’t say enough good things about The Tankless Guys! We were dealing with what felt like a major plumbing emergency, and the stress level in our house was through the roof. I made the call expecting to leave a message or wait hours for help—but they responded immediately and arrived so quickly. That alone gave us instant peace of mind.

From the moment they showed up, they were professional, courteous, and incredibly knowledgeable. They took the time to carefully assess the situation, explain what was going on in simple terms, and walk us through the options. There was no pressure, no upselling—just honest advice and a clear plan to fix the problem.

Not only did they resolve our plumbing issue efficiently, but they also went above and beyond by checking on a few additional concerns we had and making sure everything was running perfectly before they left. The quality of their work was outstanding, and they made sure the area was clean and tidy afterward, which we truly appreciated.

It’s rare to find a company that combines fast emergency response, expert craftsmanship, and genuinely caring customer service—but they absolutely delivered on all fronts. If you’re looking for reliable, trustworthy professionals who stand behind their work, I highly recommend them.

10 out of 10 service. We will definitely be recommending them to everyone we know!

user_reviews.Description:
I used Street Plumbing as they were referred by warranty company to replace my water heater. They did replace the water heater under warranty but insisted to add an expansion tank to meet code and charged $750 for the addition of the small expansion tank. Looked it up online and the tank is only $50 and they charge $300 for the tank beside installation. I agreed as the overall cost was lower than trying to do it outside of warranty with the water heater on top.

A year later I find the pipe connection is all corroded and rusted (see pic). They used a galvanized pipe which is wrong type to use for water tank. Instead of using copper pipes so it doesn't rust. This is obviously a bad workmanship and no knowledge from the tech on the right type of pipe to use.
I called them to see if they would fix it given it's obviously a bad installation. They denied their fault and said we don't warrant materials?! What materials?! They chose the wrong material for the pipe and won't stand behind their mistakes.

Got another plumber and he replaced the connection and was surprised that someone used galvanized pipe on water heater. Don't recommend them for lack of basic knowledge and for over charging.

Update: first of all there was no city inspection as this was just a water heater replacement, so don’t make up stuff. The issue here is using wrong type of pipe (galvanized), which obviously you have hard time admitting to. I’m uploading a second picture after it was fixed by another plumber for $75 using the correct copper pipes. I don’t need to do it free, it’s a small fee, I just gave you the opportunity to fix your mistake.

user_reviews.Name: aneh aja
user_reviews.Description:
4 appointments. 4 failures. Complete waste of my time.

I hired Proper Hour Home Service for drain fix and jetted tub cleaning. What followed was weeks of wasted time and broken commitments:

* Appointment 1 (Friday 2p): They cancelled at 12:30p same day due to van issues and they said it was Friday.
* Appointment 2 (Monday afternoon): I asked to reschedule to Wednesday 3p.
* Appointment 3 (Wednesday 3p): Crew arrived early. They stayed until 3:30p, then walked out without saying a word. Within minutes of the crew silently walking out, the company called me to inform me their technicians weren't "experienced or equipped" for the job, meaning they knew exactly what their crew did and why. They asked me to reschedule, again.
* Appointment 4 (Thursday 3p): At 2:55p, 5 minutes before the appointment, I received a text from "Sam" stating they were declining the project because they weren't "fully confident" their technicians could complete the work.

Here's what makes this inexcusable: if they knew their team couldn't handle the job, why did it take FOUR appointments and weeks of my time to figure that out? That cancellation text reads like a pre-written template, which makes me wonder how many other customers have received the exact same message.

My commute is 60-90 minutes each way. I lost hours across multiple days for absolutely nothing.

After the final cancellation, I texted demanding a callback from the owner or management. I was completely ghosted. No call. No follow up. Nothing.

Zero work completed. Zero accountability. Zero respect for customers' time.

Avoid Proper Hour Home Service entirely.

I had hired them in the past before for a previous job with no issues. Which is why I gave them so many chances. That makes this experience all the more disappointing.

We understand your frustration, Mr Alex Guna, and agree that the outcome was disappointing for everyone involved.

However, we would like to provide additional context. From the very beginning, we explained that jetted tub cleaning and servicing is not a specialty service that our company regularly performs. We specifically advised that we might not be able to complete the work and suggested that a specialized jetted tub service company may be a better fit. Despite that, you requested that we come out and evaluate the situation in person.

After the initial appointment was scheduled, you requested a reschedule, and we accommodated that request. During the following days, we actively tried to locate a technician who would be willing and qualified to take on the project, which is also why one of the reschedules on our side occurred. Our goal was to find a solution rather than simply decline the job immediately.

When our technician arrived, he inspected the situation and confirmed what we had previously communicated—that the scope of work was outside our area of expertise. At that point, we chose not to charge you a service call fee, even though time had been spent scheduling, dispatching, and performing the onsite evaluation.

We understand that the multiple scheduling changes were inconvenient, and for that we apologize. However, we believe it would have been irresponsible to proceed with a service that we were not fully confident we could perform properly and safely. Rather than risk causing damage or providing substandard results, we made the decision to decline the project.

For this type of work, we still recommend contacting a company that specializes in jetted tub cleaning, servicing, as they will have the equipment and expertise necessary to address the issue correctly.

We appreciate that you trusted us based on your previous positive experience, and we are sorry we were not the right fit for this particular project.

user_reviews.Name: Johnny DeLuna
user_reviews.Description:
After three other HVAC companies failed to fix our comfort issues, we were frustrated and running out of options. Each one suggested replacing equipment but couldn’t clearly explain what was actually wrong. When Calvey Heating & Air came out, the difference was immediate.

The estimator took the time to fully evaluate our system instead of jumping straight to a sales pitch. He inspected the ductwork and quickly found the real problem, our system was operating outside manufacturer specifications due to poor return airflow design and duct inefficiencies. The other companies completely missed this.

He clearly explained why our system was short-cycling, why certain rooms were uncomfortable, and how airflow problems were affecting overall efficiency. For the first time, we felt confident someone truly understood the root cause.

The installation crew was just as impressive. They reworked sections of our duct system, improved return airflow, and sealed connections to reduce leakage and increase efficiency. They installed a properly matched variable-speed heat pump system and carefully calibrated it for correct performance.

They weighed in the refrigerant charge exactly to manufacturer specs and verified system performance using superheat and subcooling measurements. Each register was adjusted to help ensure consistent temperatures throughout the home.

Now our system runs quieter, maintains steady temperatures, and uses noticeably less energy. The comfort difference is night and day.

From the knowledgeable estimator to the professional installation crew, the entire team was skilled, thorough, and solution-focused. While three other companies couldn’t figure it out, Calvey Heating & Air delivered a solution that works perfectly.

Highly recommend them for anyone who wants the job done right.

user_reviews.Name: Arthur Gu
user_reviews.Description:
Update: in response to this review, Mike Calvey reached out to me and tried to make it right.

Calvey is a company in which industry best practices are sometimes not followed.

In 2021, Calvey installed a 4-ton, single stage Bryant suitcase unit on my property.

This unit has seen less than 20 hr, likely less than 10 hr of runtime in these 3 years. It has evidence of an electrical fire due to completely loose - not even snugged connections on the contactor which should have been torqued to 35 in-lbs.

In my case, this led to the failure of the contactor, which lit on fire and shorted out the 24v control coil, which killed my Nest thermostat before blowing the fuse in my furnace.

This would very likely have been prevented if Calvey had followed industry best practices, which are to use a clamp meter to measure LRA and FLA to ensure they match the LRA/FLA rating. Taking this measurement immediately after installation helps prevent this kind of failure.

Calvey also installed a Bryant Condensing furnace on my property a few years before installing the air conditioner. The condensate pump was not wired with the safety shut off, meaning when the pump (which has a 5-10 year expected service life) inevitably fails, it will likely cause a flood in my mechanical room. Calvey not only failed to install the necessary wiring for the safe operation of the condensing furnace, they also failed to correct this error when installing an air conditioner several years later.

Further, some Calvey techs informed me they use 5% silver phos-copper brazing filler. Industry best practices are to use 15% silver phos-copper brazing filler because it has better flow characteristics, and lower odds of cracking with vibration/thermal expansion. 5% brazing filler is also often associated with the practice of "crowning" a joint, wherein rather than flowing braze into the joint, a crown is applied around the joint with very minimal penetration. I have not experienced a failure due to this, it is still a poor practice.

Calvey did not follow industry best practices in the installation of my HVAC system. The electrical fire and subsequent damage to the entire 24v electrical system of my home, as well as the sub-optimal brazing alloy and improper condensate pump installation, I cannot in good conscience recommend this company for your next HVAC project.

user_reviews.Name: KENNETH GELFAND
user_reviews.Description: Aaron is awesome I'm really surprised that there's even a single bad review on this business. My house is an old Eckler style home with THE WORST sewage system you could ever imagine. I won't go into the details about it but it's a tricky plumbing situation. I had some other plumbing company come out and they couldn't fix my drain blockage after 2 hours and some outrageous quote to dig up my pipes. It was a nightmare. Aaron came out the same day about an hours after I called. He put an incredible amount of effort into unclogging it but it just wouldn't budge. He knew he needed to use a blow bag to punch it through but unfortunately Home Depot was already closed and he didn't have one on hand. He promised to come back the next morning (it was like 10pm) and fix it. Didn't ask for any payment either which I thought, wow this guy is super honorable, didn't ask for pay because he wanted to fix it first. Came back the next morning and had it cleared out easily in like 25 minutes. The experience Aaron has is invaluable. He knows his stuff and he's friendly. Old school style service where you feel like your uncle came over to fix your plumbing issue. I will NEVER call another plumber again. Trust me, save money and get better services with The Plumbing Guys and Aaron.

user_reviews.Description:
I would give a negative 10 if that was a possibility.  Worst experience ever with Aaron!  I hired him to disconnect the waterline for my fridge as I bought a new fridge without water or ice maker.  He went off to get a part he said and it took him 4 hours to get back and then he spent half hour and said it was done and invoiced us over $300.
My refrigerator arrived next day and when the delivery guys came they found that the water was not disconnected.  So they delivered the fridge,  but didn’t haul away the old fridge (I paid for that service) and now I had one new fridge in my living room and old one in the kitchen. I called him back and he told me he was coming to fix it. He told me he was 10 minutes away and the 10 minutes became a day later and 2 days later and then I gave up.  3 days later he said he was parking in the garage across my street - a two minute walk at most or an 5 minute walk for people with mobility issues.  He took whole 45 minutes to get to my condo.

He disconnected the fridge after again disappearing for over an hour to find a part it seems and comes back at 11 pm fixes the problem and leaves.  Now I find that there is no hot water coming from any faucet.  He then sends me a rude message this morning about my attitude.  Wow!  Some nerve he has.

Now I have called someone else to come check the guy’s work.  I have to pay them another 300 dollars!

PLEASE NEVER NEVER EVER EVER USE THIS GUY !!! He has no knowledge of plumbing and absolutely no sense of time.

user_reviews.Name: Anna Quan
user_reviews.Description:
We used Marti's Plumbing Service for an emergency water heater change-out in June, 2021. We also asked that they apply for a building permit on our behalf, and Marti's agreed.

The technician sent by Marti's did not install all of the necessary parts for the water heater. He also cut the line between the water heater and the washer and caused a leak. Only after multiple conversations did Marti's compensate us for the amount that we had paid to repair the leak.

Marti's also refused to apply for a building permit after their initial promise, so I applied for a water heater change-out permit on my own. I received the following list of corrections from the City of Cupertino's building inspector. I called Marti's many times to bring the water heater up to code, because they provide a one-year warranty with their services, but it was very difficult to reach them to schedule a follow-up visit.

City of Cupertino's List of Required Corrections:

1. Single wall vent connector for water heater requires 6" min clearance to combustibles ( Sheetrock ) and single wall connector not approved for penetrating rated assembly.
2. Provide access to vent flue to verify B-vent or install new for water heater flue.
3. Provide insulation on first 5'ft of water lines at water heater
4. T&P piping at termination to not be threaded and to terminate 6-24" off garage floor or pipe to exterior and maintain same termination clearance off ground surface
5. Water heater to be fully blocked and braced
6. Water heater bracing at lower brace to be located within bottom 1/3 and 4" above control valve
7. Tighten water heater bracing
8. Provide water bond hot to cold and to gas line.
9. Provide approved expansion tank brace and install per manufactures installation instructions
10. Provide sediment trap on gas line after the valve and before the flex

user_reviews.reply_text_original:
Hi Cindy,

Thank you for your review, we appreciate the opportunity to respond.

This service call was scheduled through your property management company, and we were dispatched to assess a report of standing water near a floor drain. Our technician inspected the area, identified that the drain had been sealed over with concrete, and explained that addressing it would require concrete removal and a new floor drain installation. No repair work was authorized, and the recommended service was declined.

Although the technician was on-site for a short time, our $280 fee reflects our standard 2-hour minimum for service calls. This covers the technician’s time, travel, professional assessment, and the administrative work that follows, including documentation, reporting, and correspondence. This fee is typically waived if the customer moves forward with the recommended work, but in this case, no additional service was scheduled.

We understand that you were not made aware of this policy prior to the visit, and we’ll continue to improve communication around service minimums in the future. As a small business ourselves, we strive to provide fair, professional service while remaining sustainable and we always welcome the chance to resolve concerns directly. Please feel free to reach out if you'd like to continue the conversation.

user_reviews.Description:
Super unprofessional. Seems like the plumber just wants money and does not care if problem is actually solved or not.

I called him 15 days ago to inspect and fix a bathroom clog. He came a ran a snake for 2-3 minutes and the water started draining. He asked for a higher than normal fee, and I gave it without argument as he responded promptly to my call and came immediately.

I left for a 2 week vacation next morning and on return found the bathroom drain was still getting clogged. I sent a message to him but he did not respond. I tried again the next day and he picked up the phone. Now here is where his unprofessional behavior starts. He blamed me that I might have thrown something in the toilet to cause the clog. I explain that no one was home and that the snake cleaning he did 2 weeks did not seem to have cleared the clog. Even after my clear explanation he kept telling me that I should have done something wrong.

I decided to get a snake from homedepot and run it myself.

I ran the snake thoroughly and was able to extract roots from the pipe around 10-15 ft mark. See the pictures. There probably was more that got flushed out.

Stay away from this company if you are seeking honest and genuine service. I would rather find someone who is honest and do the right thing.

user_reviews.Name: Don Roberts
user_reviews.Description:
If you're skimming reviews, then then I'll just recommend you give Drain Rooter Service a call. If you're like me, you'll be delighted you did.

Backstory - Last night at 7 PM (of course, a couple hours after sunset this time of year), my son emerges from his shower saying, "Dad, the water is not draining in my shower". As you can imagine, that's something we never want to hear. But, there it was. After getting numerous towels in place to soak up the water in two back-to-back bathrooms (thankfully, it was shower water, not poo water), it was time to get someone out to my house quickly to get the sewer line flowing again.

I looked back a a previous review I did in 2018 for a drain service I recall being happy with. I called them, but I got a voicemail indicating they had closed for the day - just an hour before. With this situation being what it was, waiting until the morning in the hopes of getting into the service schedule wasn't going to work.

So, I began looking through reviews. I quickly came across Drain Rooter Service, and I liked the reviews I was reading. I saw that they were open until 9 PM, so I gave them a call at about 7:15 PM expecting to have to leave a message. To my surprise, "Todd" answered the phone and asked me how he could help. As it turns out, he was just finishing another service appointment, and he asked me to text him my address. I did, and he was at my house within 25-mins. That was a "Wow!"

Todd quickly diagnosed the problem, and offered to power-snake my main sewer-line for a reasonable price. I was glad to hear he had a power-snake because the results of a previous hydro-jet service had only lasted two-weeks. Then, I had to pay a different service to do it again using a power-snake.

user_reviews.Name: Uygar Aral
user_reviews.Description:
I have worked with Elber from Drain & Plumbing on a couple occasions and he is excellent at his craft.

The first time I worked with him, it was an urgent situation where I needed the the hot and cold valves for our Washing Machine replaced in order to have our new Washer installed. The original valves had a lot of deposit build up, so when we tried to hand close it, it would still leak.

When I contacted Elber that morning, he had told me that scope would be too much for him to handle in the morning, because he was already committed to another project. However, he was able to come by later that day and in a few hours, he was able to replace both valves and the Outlet Box. 2 years later, it is still as good as new without any issues.

The second time I worked with Elber was for 2 tasks. I needed the PRV (Pressure Reducing Valve) replaced as it had severely corroded and the gasket inside was failing. We had been having water pressure issues and it was attributed to the original PRV. The second task was to install a Fleck 5600 Water Softener system that I had purchased online from Aplus Water via Amazon. Elber was able to complete both tasks in about 8 hours including having to buy the PRV as well as some additional copper pipes to ensure that he properly welded and installed the piping.

You can see from the pictures how corroded the original PRV was, simply based on the pipe surrounding the new install. He was able to easily and quickly replace the old PRV without incident.

The Water Softener took longer to install, but he was meticulously done. He made sure to properly survey the installation space and area in the garage. He reviewed and inspected the parts/connections as well as confirmed the installation process via the manual. I actively worked with him to ensure that everything needed to prepare in advance was good: verified the location and how it would be installed; verified where the closes drain would be that required him to enter the crawl space; verified all necessary parts from the manufacturer were good, before starting.

He went off to pick up some additional material to ensure that he would install and setup the resin tank and brine basin in a secure and clean setup. As you can see from the pictures he properly secured and mounted the system, performed the necessary and appropriate plumbing work to ensure all the interconnects were done properly. He then also ensured the drain from the resin tank ran properly under the house to the nearby drain.

Throughout the installation process, I occasionally checked in but did not need to hover over him. Overall the project took longer than he anticipated and expected, but he did not charge me extra. He had already scoped the project, previously, and committed to his original quote.

Elber at Drain & Plumbing is polite, honest, and easy to communicate with. Most importantly, he is extremely skilled and meticulous with his work. The quality of his workmanship is fantastic and I can't imagine is matched.

I do not plan to ever reach out to anybody else but Elber for any of my plumbing needs.

Of my near 60 recommendations, at the time of this review, Elber at Drain & Plumbing is easily in the Top 3 of my recommendations.

user_reviews.Name: Carol Yamane
user_reviews.Description:
In October, the hot water shower fixture got stuck I contacted Local Rooter and Plumbing for assistance. The valves in the hot and cold fixtures were replaced by Local Rooter and Plumbing in 2021 and the cold water fixture was tightened in 2024. Since this was the 3rd issue with the shower fixtures, Duy recommended converting the fixtures from 2 handle to single handle. During the conversion, Jaime found the plumbing was galvanized steel and recommended installing copper piping. A hole was cut in the wall behind the shower and the pipe was replaced. Wall patch, texturing, and painting was done once the job was completed.
I also asked Duy for advice regarding replacing the gas hot water heater. Since the heater was 21 years old, Duy suggested replacing the hot water heater with another gas water heater after a discussion about converting to an all electric one.
Duy is very responsive to emergency plumbing issues by scheduling an appointment within hours, all of my emergencies happened on a weekend. He explains the problem and repairs required well.  I also had him replace the original plumbing under the house in 2021. I highly recommend this company.
